# SaveYourLuckBruh

> SaveYourLuckBruh is persists vanilla valheim bad luck protection counters across game sessions and world transitions. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Drop table RNG mitigation and persistent bad luck tracking**: Drop table RNG mitigation and persistent bad luck tracking.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal persistence stores**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal persistence stores.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/SaveYourLuckBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
